paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: The influence of number of blanks to .
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of blanks and accuracy. The x-axis, labeled "# Blanks", has a linear scale with a value range of 1 to 6, and tick labels at regular intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", also has a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 70, and tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot features a single blue line with diamond markers and a solid line style, representing Qwen2.5-VL-72B. The line starts at approximately 68% accuracy when there is 1 blank and decreases to around 5% accuracy when there are 6 blanks, with notable declines between 1 and 2 blanks, from around 68% to 20%, and then levels off with smaller decreases, passing through points such as around 15% at 3 blanks, 10% at 4 blanks, and 5% at 6 blanks.
